questions.prompt: Which fractions have terminating decimals? Choose all that apply.
questions.explain: 8, 20 and 25 have only the prime factors 2 and 5. 6 and 9 have a factor of 3, so they recur.

questions.prompt: Write the fraction as a decimal.
Which fraction equals 0.333… (the 3s go on forever)?
questions.explain: 1 ÷ 3 = 0.333… exactly. (3/9 also equals 1/3, but it isn't in lowest terms.)

questions.prompt: 1/7 = 0.142857142857… How many digits are in the repeating block?
questions.explain: The block 142857 repeats. Dividing by 7 has at most 6 possible non-zero remainders, so the block has at most 6 digits.

questions.prompt: Which of these are rational numbers? Choose all that apply.
questions.explain: All of them! A rational number can be written as p/q with integers p and q (q ≠ 0): 0 = 0/1, 5 = 5/1, 0.25 = 1/4.

questions.prompt: Find the rational number exactly halfway between 1/4 and 1/2.
Without dividing, explain how you know 3/40 has a terminating decimal.
questions.modelAnswer: 3/40 is in lowest terms, and 40 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 has only the prime factors 2 and 5. So 3/40 can be rewritten with a denominator that is a power of 10 (3/40 = 75/1000 = 0.075), which means the decimal stops.
rubric: Prime factors of 40 are only 2s and 5s
questions.explain: Criterion C: communicate a clear, logical argument.
